tinyblocks.guide.page.1:
§lTinyBlocks§r

Build with blocks smaller than a block. Each real block can hold a grid of tiny pieces that work like normal blocks: redstone, Create machines and more.

This guide explains each item.
tinyblocks.guide.page.2:
§lMinimizer§r

Hold it in your off-hand and any block in your main hand. Placing the block makes a tiny piece.

Clicking a grid places into it. Reaching past its edge starts the next grid.
tinyblocks.guide.page.3:
§lMinimizer size§r

Right-click the air with it in your main hand to pick the cell size, from 1/2 to 1/16.

1/1 places normal blocks. Odd sizes have a middle cell, which lines up with a full-size shaft.
tinyblocks.guide.page.4:
§lBuild modes§r

Shift+G changes mode: Normal, Fill, Hollow, Walls or Plane.

Click one corner, then the other. Ctrl + scroll sets the height. Sneak-click cancels. At most 8192 cells.
tinyblocks.guide.page.5:
§lLocked§r

With the Minimizer in your off-hand, right-click the air to lock it: it glows.

With it in either hand, you only break pieces of grids of its size. Right-click the air again to unlock.
tinyblocks.guide.page.6:
§lMinimize me§r

Press X with a Minimizer in hand to shrink yourself to its size and walk inside your builds. Press it again to return to full size.

The key can be changed in Controls.
tinyblocks.guide.page.7:
§lShaft Connector§r

Joins a grid's tiny machines to the big ones outside. It sits on one face of the grid.

Click a tiny shaft with it to place it at the end of that shaft's line.
tinyblocks.guide.page.8:
§lConnector shapes§r

Odd grid: a funnel. A block clicked onto it goes in its socket, the middle cell.

Even grid: a gear. Small tiny cogwheels go on its sides, and the mechanism runs from them.
tinyblocks.guide.page.9:
§lUsing a connector§r

A wrench moves it to the next free face. Sneak + wrench takes it apart.

Without a Minimizer, a block clicked on its wide end goes outside: a big shaft lines up with it, no support needed.
tinyblocks.guide.page.10:
§lGrid Save§r

Carries a whole grid. Click a grid to take it with all its pieces; nothing drops.

Holding it shows a ghost of the grid. R turns it. Click to place it, and machines and links keep working.
tinyblocks.guide.page.11:
§lSeveral grids§r

Sneak-click one corner with an empty Grid Save, then click the other. It takes up to 4 grids, at most 4 blocks a side.

Sneak-click the air to cancel the selection.
